title: Stage-0 Bootstrap Runner
description: Implement `bootstrap.py` in the root directory. This is a zero-dependency, pure Python standard library script. Its only job is to read one JSON envelope from `mailbox/inbox/`, print its contents to the console (simulating dispatch), and move it to `mailbox/outbox/`. This breaks the bootstrap paradox.

requirements.stdlib_only: Must use ONLY `json`, `os`, `shutil`, `sys`. No external dependencies.
requirements.execution_logic: Scan `mailbox/inbox/`. Pick the first `.json` file. Read it. Print 'DISPATCHING WORKORDER: <id>'. Move file to `mailbox/outbox/`.

acceptance_criteria: Running `python bootstrap.py` successfully moves an envelope from inbox to outbox.
failure_modes: FAIL: Using any external library like `pydantic` or `requests`.
